Package edu.uky.cs.nil.sg

Interface GraphWriter

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
All Known Implementing Classes:
ArchiveWriter, DirectoryWriter
public interface GraphWriter extends AutoCloseable
An interface for writing a story graph to an output destination. Though a story graph is segmented into "files," the destination does not actually need to store the data in files as long as segments can be written to via the setFile(String) method.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware
